prompt: David always did the check-in. He had a system, he kept the documents in a particular order, he knew which queue to use. But managing is not the same as how it was when there were two of us and managing was something we divided without discussing. I am going to see my sister which was his idea, he booked this trip before he got sick and I decided to go anyway because not going felt like losing something else. What do you do at the hotel if they have booked a double room?
